ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a Huangshan mountain landscape. In the scene there are tree shadows shaped like the Guest-Greeting Pine and silhouettes of mountain peaks; the sun is located near the ridge or horizon, the light is very low, presenting a state of just rising. In the lower left corner of the figure, the shooting time can be read as “05:50”. Then reason: The stem states that the location is Huangshan. At 05:50 the sun is already visible near the horizon, indicating that this is sunrise time, and that the local area is in the summer half of the year when days are long and nights are short and sunrise is relatively early. Huangshan is located in the Northern Hemisphere, and in the Northern Hemisphere’s summer half of the year, the sun rises from the northeast. Therefore at this time the sun is located northeast of the photographer.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出太阳刚从地平线附近升起且拍摄时间为05:50；再结合题干给出的地点“黄山”。05:50已能看到日出，说明当地处于昼长夜短的夏半年；黄山在北半球，夏半年日出方位在东北。因此此时太阳位于拍摄者的东北方。
